body:
Self-contained specification for `bin/hook-runner.sh` `PASSWD_HOME` audit-log anchoring and fallback read-only updates.

IMPORTANT HEADLESS WORKER SHELL RULE: In this headless worker session, `PreToolUse` allows ONLY `node --test test/hook-runner.test.mjs` and `npm test` (plus pure read commands `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `grep`, `ls`, `wc`, `git status`, `git diff`, `git log`). Do NOT run `shellcheck`, `npm run build`, `node -e`, `sh`, or env-prefixed commands — they are intentionally blocked by `PreToolUse` in worker mode and are NOT needed (`npm test` runs automatically as the scheduler gate after your turn).

1. `bin/hook-runner.sh`:
   - Keep strict POSIX `/bin/sh` syntax (no bashisms like `[[`, arrays, or `local`).
   - In `emit_fallback` (`IS_READ_ONLY` `case "$TOOL_NAME"` around line 204): add `list_dir|list_permissions|search_in_file|wait|wait_5_seconds` to the read-only tool list, and split `manage_task` into its own `manage_task)` arm that sets `IS_READ_ONLY=1` ONLY when `! grep -Eq '"[Aa]ction"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"(kill|send_input)"' "$TMP_FLAT" 2>/dev/null`.
   - Implement `PASSWD_HOME` audit-log anchoring at the top of `bin/hook-runner.sh` (replacing lines 14–20):
     1. Compute `RUNNER_DIR="$(CDPATH='' cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd -P)"` and `RUNNER_ROOT="$(dirname -- "$RUNNER_DIR")"` upfront (and reuse them for `LAUNCHER_DIR`/`PLUGIN_ROOT`).
     2. Resolve OS account home `PASSWD_HOME="$(getent passwd "$(id -u)" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f6)"` (with macOS fallback `if [ -z "$PASSWD_HOME" ] && command -v dscl >/dev/null 2>&1; then PASSWD_HOME="$(dscl . -read "/Users/$(id -un)" NFSHomeDirectory 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')"; fi`).
     3. Staging check: in `case "$RUNNER_ROOT" in */.gemini/config/plugins/*)` **unconditionally ignore `AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME` and `HOME`** for log resolution (`EFF_HOME="$PASSWD_HOME"`, falling back to `${RUNNER_ROOT%%/.gemini/*}` verified via `[ -O ... ]` only if `EFF_HOME` is empty). When `RUNNER_ROOT` is outside `*/.gemini/config/plugins/*`: if `[ -n "$AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME" ] && [ -f "$RUNNER_ROOT/test/hook-runner.test.mjs" ]` set `EFF_HOME="$AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME"`; else if `[ -n "$HOME" ]` set `EFF_HOME="$HOME"` (so existing `test/hook-runner.test.mjs` temp `PLUGIN` copies that set `HOME: HOME_DIR` or `HOME: roHome` continue isolating logs cleanly!); else set `EFF_HOME="$PASSWD_HOME"`.
     4. Canonical `PLUGIN_DATA` resolution: define POSIX helper `resolve_no_symlink_root()` that rejects relative paths, walks prefix components from `/` down to target checking `[ ! -L "$_prefix" ]` on every existing component (returning 1 on any symlink), resolves existing directory components via `(CDPATH='' cd -- "$_existing" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)` plus non-existent trailing segments, and accepts `PLUGIN_DATA` iff that resolved path equals one of the 4 exact strings `${EFF_HOME}/.gemini/antigravity-cli/plugin_data/antigravity-booster`, `${EFF_HOME}/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/antigravity-booster`, `${EFF_HOME}/.gemini/antigravity-ide/plugin_data/antigravity-booster`, or `${EFF_HOME}/.config/antigravity-booster`; otherwise set `DATA_ROOT="${EFF_HOME}/.gemini/antigravity-cli/plugin_data/antigravity-booster"`.
     5. Set `umask 0077`, `HOOK_LOG_DIR="$DATA_ROOT/logs"`, `HOOK_LOG_FILE="$HOOK_LOG_DIR/hooks.log"`, `LOG_TAMPERED=0`, `LOG_DEGRADED=0`. Detect tampering (`LOG_TAMPERED=1` if `[ -L "$DATA_ROOT" ] || [ -L "$HOOK_LOG_DIR" ] || [ -L "$HOOK_LOG_FILE" ] || ( [ -e "$HOOK_LOG_DIR" ] && [ ! -O "$HOOK_LOG_DIR" ] ) || ( [ -e "$HOOK_LOG_FILE" ] && [ ! -O "$HOOK_LOG_FILE" ] )`): on `LOG_TAMPERED=1`, set `LOG_DEGRADED=1`, `HOOK_LOG_FILE="/dev/null"`, best-effort write `0600` `${EFF_HOME}/.gemini/antigravity-cli/.agb-hook-log-degraded`, emit `stderr` warning, and in headless workers (`[ -n "$AGB_WORKER_TICKET" ] || [ -n "$AGB_WORKER_MODE" ]`) immediately emit `{"decision":"deny","reason":"agb hook audit log tampered in headless worker"}` and `exit 0`. When NOT tampered, `mkdir -p "$HOOK_LOG_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true`, create if absent via `( set -C; : >"$HOOK_LOG_FILE" ) 2>/dev/null || true`, and test `( : >>"$HOOK_LOG_FILE" ) 2>/dev/null`: if read-only/unwritable (e.g. `bwrap` `--ro-bind` `$HOME/.gemini` in `test/hook-runner.test.mjs:689-707`), set `LOG_DEGRADED=1` (NOT `LOG_TAMPERED`), `HOOK_LOG_FILE="/dev/null"`, best-effort write `.agb-hook-log-degraded` if writable, append ` [audit-log-degraded]` on fallback JSON `reason`s in `emit_fallback`, and allow normal child execution so `test/hook-runner.test.mjs:689-707` stays 100% green!

2. Tests (`test/hook-runner.test.mjs`):
   - Add tests verifying: (a) all 4 canonical `PLUGIN_DATA` roots under `AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME` (with `test/hook-runner.test.mjs` marker present in the test plugin root) write `logs/hooks.log`, while rogue `PLUGIN_DATA=/tmp/evil` and symlinked `PLUGIN_DATA` are rejected; (b) staging `bin/hook-runner.sh` into `<tmp>/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-booster/bin/hook-runner.sh` ignores `AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME` (test with a fake `getent` shim on `PATH` returning `<tmp>/passwd-home` so the test never writes to the real host user home!); (c) symlinked `HOOK_LOG_DIR` or `HOOK_LOG_FILE` denies headless workers immediately (`decision === 'deny'`); (d) `list_dir` passes through in fallback while `manage_task` with `"Action":"kill"` denies in headless fallback.
   - Verify with `node --test test/hook-runner.test.mjs` and finish cleanly (do NOT print `TICKET-BLOCKED`).

edges.contract: t-hook-runner-passwd-home hardens bin/hook-runner.sh with PASSWD_HOME staging detection, the 4-root PLUGIN_DATA allowlist, symlink/UID tamper fail-closed denial, and fallback read-only tool updates, verified in test/hook-runner.test.mjs.

title: Enforce PASSWD_HOME audit-log anchoring and 4-root PLUGIN_DATA allowlist in hook-runner.sh
